Removes GTA 6 content from YouTube and X before you see it: videos, Shorts, posts, trends and comments.

**Strict mode** (toggle in the popup or settings) also hides all other GTA games and everything Rockstar Games makes.

## Download

- **Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi** (any Chromium browser): `sixbegone-…-chrome.zip`
- **Firefox 128 or newer**: `sixbegone-…-firefox.zip`

Install steps are in the [README](https://github.com/onni-min/SixBeGone#install).

**Updating from 1.0?** Chromium: unzip the new file over your old folder, then click ↻ reload on SixBeGone's card on the extensions page. If X isn't filtered after that, remove SixBeGone and click **Load unpacked** again so the browser picks up the new X permission. Firefox: load the new zip the same way as before.

> Unofficial. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.
